latest.name: Lumi Launcher v0.6.2 (Pre-review Build)
latest.body:
Public pre-review update for source verification and Mojang AppID review. The launcher behaves the same as v0.6.1; this build refreshes the demo data behind the live browser demo on the official website.

> **Note:** Microsoft sign-in is intentionally disabled in this pre-review build until Mojang approves Lumi's AppID. You can still inspect the launcher UI, manage instances/saves, browse Modrinth/CurseForge, and verify ownership-gate behavior.
>
> NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

### What's Changed
- The demo world cover is now an unedited in-game screenshot (taken with the HUD hidden).
- Demo instances, servers and icons are now original placeholders instead of third-party modpack names and logos.
- Demo download counts are toned down to realistic figures.

### Verification
Please verify file integrity against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

releases.name: Lumi Launcher v0.6.1 (Pre-review Build)
releases.body:
Public pre-review update for source verification and Mojang AppID review, refreshing all 17 visual assets to original pure-2D vector artwork.

> **Note:** Microsoft sign-in is intentionally disabled in this pre-review build until Mojang approves Lumi's AppID. You can still inspect the launcher UI, manage instances/saves, browse Modrinth/CurseForge, and verify ownership-gate behavior.
>
> NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

### What's Changed
- Replaced all 17 visual assets (6 status spot illustrations, 6 adaptive interface scenes, and the Windows installer backdrop) with original pure-2D vector artwork responsive to light/dark themes and per-world accent colors.
- Updated interactive preview fixtures with HUD-free world cover artwork and native bilingual demo data.
